data.raw_text:
Oplan Kontra Baha in Batanes, where site assessments were conducted using available online hazard maps and validated through local knowledge gathered over a year-long series of consultations with the LGUs.

Since April 2025, UP RI-NOAH has been working with local communities across the six municipalities of Batanes Province under a project funded by the Asia-Pacific Network for Global Change Research (APN), titled “Bridging Academic Researchers and Vulnerable Island Communities in the Philippines: Enhancing Capacities for Climate and Disaster Risk Management of Low-Income Municipalities in Batanes, Philippines.”

Inspections conducted with the teams of Sec. Vince Dizon and Governor Ronald Aguto Jr.

Public service of the University of the Philippines
